messages:
Ava S: Quick morning pulse — ticket count at the desk is 42 (+8 since yesterday). Biggest chunks: webhook failures (18), embeddings regressions (6), billing duplicates (3). I'm heads-down in onboarding until 10:30 but will pick up webhook triage after. If anyone's taking macros or PRs, shout now.

Liam R: On webhooks — saw a 15m 5xx spike starting 02:12 UTC. traces point to payments-webhook -> collector timeouts. I pushed a hotfix PR #912 to add exponential retry + jitter, waiting for review. Can someone confirm the customer-facing macro text for 'temporary retry' steps?

SupportBot: incident-alert: webhook-error-rate > 5% for payments-webhook (02:12-02:28 UTC). Pager duty: on-call=Liam_R. Logs attached: link to logs.cloud/xyz.

Maya T: I'll take the macro. Rewording to include immediate steps + temporary workaround. ETA ~25m. Draft below, LMK edits: 

```
Title: Webhook delivery failures (temporary)
Steps:
1) We're investigating delivery failures for webhooks to 3rd-party collectors.
2) Try re-sending the webhook from the developer console.
3) If you see 5xx from our side, toggle "retry" in your integration settings (we're pushing automatic retries).
4) If urgent, add the payload to the manual resend queue: /support/resend <ticket-id>.
Expected update: 30-60 minutes.
```

Theo P: FWIW embeddings regression: traced root-cause to an automated model switch to `embed-v2-quant` last night. Reverting to `embed-v1` drops mismatch errors back to baseline. Opened PR #914 to pin model for the rollout pipeline and a rollback job. Recommend: route new embedding requests from dedicated accounts to `embed-v1` until we validate.

Liam R: Nice catch — thanks Theo. I'll prioritize review on #914. Also will add a short note to the webhook macro to advise customers to include request_id when they open a ticket.

Ava S: Heads-up: 3 billing duplicates are probably correlated with the webhook retries hitting idempotency gaps. @Maya T can we add a line to billing macro to note "if you see duplicated charges, we will refund in 3-5 business days and are investigating"?

Maya T: Yes, adding billing line now. Also folding in the request_id template and a one-click copy snippet. Pushing macro edits to /macros/hotfixs by EOD.

Liam R: Small ops note — if anyone is performing rollbacks, use the rollback tag: `rb:hotfix` in PR title so our console routes incidents to on-call correctly.

Theo P: Also opened a lightweight smoke test job to run after any model pin change: `jobs/smoke-embed-check` (runs 5 test vectors, compares cosine similarity delta). Will attach results to the PR.

Ava S: Perfect. Quick PR pings: @Liam_R review #912, @Theo_P review #914, @Maya_T update macros and confirm when the billing line is live. I'll follow up after onboarding for handoff. :thumbsup:

SupportBot: note: #912 merged to staging at 02:34 UTC. #914 is in review. Macro update queued.

Maya T: Billing line added and deployed to staging. Live to prod once I get signoff from ops (should be <1h).

Liam R: Reviewing #914 now. If all good I'll merge and trigger a pinned-model rollout to dedicated pool (canary 10% first).

Ava S: Thanks team — if anything blocks merge ping here. I'll close this thread after midday check unless new issues surface.

Theo P: No blockers from infra side. Will monitor embedding smoke job and post results.

Maya T: will follow up on prod macro deploy.

SupportBot: thread note appended: last-activity=1766000147.
